source: UN DESA World Population Prospects 2024, INED

slides.headline: China could lose over half its people by 2100
slides.subline: **UN projection:** from 1,416 million today to about 633 million.

slides.body: The UN projects China's population falls from about **1,416 million in 2025** to about [[633 million in 2100]]. That could be the largest population loss of any country.
**India** peaks near 1.7 billion in the early 2060s, then declines to about 1.5 billion, yet stays [[number one]]. The **US** grows to 421 million but slips from third place to [[sixth]].
These are **projections**, not promises. They rest on assumptions about births, deaths and migration. Which of these countries will surprise us most? Tell us below.
